attBesluta.text: This wet-dry separation system keeps areas divided, prevents mixing, and maintains hygienic conditions.
Very sanitary and functional, ideal for spaces requiring dry and wet zone separation.
Easy to use, system stays neat and tidy, separation performance is efficient and easy to clean.
Highly effective and durable system, ensures reliable separation and serves many practical uses.
Perfect for bathroom, kitchen, and workshop use, protects against moisture damage effectively.

I bought this door for my bathroom and I'm extremely satisfied. It doesn't deform even with constant humidity, slides smoothly and has a high-quality finish. It's easy to clean, requires no special maintenance and has greatly improved the functionality of my home bathroom.

This wet and dry separation bathroom door is an outstanding product. It perfectly separates the two areas of the bathroom, preventing water from spreading and making cleaning much easier. The installation is intuitive, the material is moisture-resistant and it has a very attractive design. Highly recommended for anyone looking to organize their bathroom better.

Very well made heavy glass door! Instructions could be better but the online video made the install easier if you are handy. This door calls for metric drill bits & tile bits sizes not easily available. Measurements are in metric so you have to be able to convert to inches.
Well made, solid track and wheel bearing, Heavy duty glass...Good product...
This sliding bathtub door has impressed me with its solid construction and ease of use. It meets European quality expectations and feels like a product designed with real attention to detail.
I installed it myself, it wasn't quite big enough for the space so I had to put a black pool fence pole in next to it so that it fits. It is good.

The instructions need a lot of improvement. ie there is no instructions on the silicone application and when to apply. There are no handles on the inside. Advise: apply silicone when installing the full length bar
